g.title: failures
g.text: Java Pet Store — Failure Scenarios & How the Fleet Recovers
green = safe outcome / recovery · red = terminal / operator signal · every value below is enforced in code

g.title: cluster_msg
g.text: 1 · Async consumer FAILS to process a message (e.g. DB blip)

g.title: cluster_outbox
g.text: 2 · OPC cannot PUBLISH an outbound event (broker down)

g.title: o_trigger
g.text: event written to outbox table in the
business tx; OutboxRelay tries to publish

g.title: o_ok
g.text: broker back → sent exactly the frozen

g.title: o_park
g.text: ERROR logged, skipped by future polls
(no DLQ — it never reached the broker)

g.title: d_ok
g.text: replay is a no-op → stock not

g.title: c_trigger
g.text: one approves & one denies the SAME

g.title: b_allnone
g.text: order stays APPROVED for later restock
